source: Dett Elementary School Annex and Renovations (PBC Chicago, C1604), Addenda 1-6, public bid documents (2023)
how: Extracted by scripts/extract_drawing_lists.py from the section "This Addendum includes the following attached Drawings:" in each addendum PDF (pdftotext -layout). Every numbered item was kept; item numbers run 1..N with no gaps. Addendum 4 attached no drawings.
note: Each addendum also says: "Drawings/specifications corresponding to inquiry responses will be issued with the Issue for Construction Documents, upon issuance of building permit." So an RFI answer that changes the design but has no revised sheet in an addendum still has to be carried into the IFC set.
